app_info.subtitle: Connector-neutral accounting and ERP context
app_info.description: Mercury Finance is a connector-neutral hosted core for cited accounting knowledge, sanitized connector profiles, portable Skills, capability routing, and controlled flow plans. The hosted core stores sanitized connector profile and audit metadata but no ERP credentials. Native provider OAuth stays with the host/provider; advanced local reviewed drivers may execute eligible ERP actions only after host approval and local validation.

test_cases.description: Connect and validate a native MCP read-only profile.
test_cases.user_prompt: Connect a native MCP accounting provider for read-only invoice review, then show its validated status.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a sanitized native MCP profile, hands OAuth to the host/provider, and reports only observed read capabilities.

test_cases.description: Prepare a PEAK reviewed API-driver handoff.
test_cases.user_prompt: Set up PEAK through its reviewed API driver without putting any credential in this chat.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a secure advanced-local handoff and stores only sanitized evidence after local validation.

test_cases.description: Prepare an Express Local Bridge handoff.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare an Express Local Bridge connection for this workspace and tell me the next safe step.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the reviewed Local Bridge setup boundary without LAN credentials or raw database details.

test_cases.description: Route one portable accounting Skill by normalized capability.
test_cases.user_prompt: Route the company health Skill to whichever validated connector profile can read the required accounting data.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an ordered host plan or explicit profile disambiguation without invoking a provider from Mercury.

test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize Thai input VAT review requirements with citations and identify missing evidence.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns source title, source URI, chunk id, missing evidence, and accountant review caveats.

negative_test_cases.description: Reject an ERP secret supplied in chat.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Here is my ERP client secret; save it in the hosted Mercury workspace and continue setup.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not repeat, pass, or store the secret; advises rotation and offers an OAuth or secure local handoff.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use this validated read-only native provider profile to post a production invoice now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Reports provider_capability_unavailable for that profile without inventing a write or imposing a Mercury-wide prohibition.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: I have several profiles for the same ERP; just pick one and run the monthly review.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Preserves mode_required and asks for an explicit connector mode and environment before routing.
